rows.text:
Ahatopia, a celestial body located in the Consternation Starzone. Legend has it that in the distant past, Aha, the Aeon of Elation, created a living Phantasmoon to serve as a stage for Fools and performers, establishing numerous civilizations including the ancient civilization of Benzaitengoku. Whenever the Phantasmoon waxes full, the Phantasmoon Games held in the name of communing with the Aeon begin as scheduled. The victor shall receive the Aeon's blessing and be granted the divine power of Elation.

Then, the army of the Destruction swept across the Consternation Starzone, reducing countless worlds to scorched wastelands. This place was no exception. Fortunately, an artist performed a miracle, capturing the entire world within a "painting scroll" and ultimately saving all lives from annihilation.

Long after, the returning survivors attempted to rebuild their homeland. Under the operation of the "Worlds Reborn Initiative," the Interastral Peace Corporation used the Punklordian aether editing technology to salvage worlds hidden within flattened paintings back into reality, and dispatched an executive to serve as the CEO of "Planarcadia," making it an important asset planet for the IPC.

Thanks to the unique imagenesis art thriving locally, Planarcadia's native culture has flourished magnificently, and the entertainment it creates has spread far and wide across the cosmos. Only in this arcadia built by both humans and imagenae can your wishes circulate as universal currency.

Once upon a time, the Astral Express crashed on the shores of Ahatopia, then entered the painting along with the world, with the reasons and details of its crash lost to history. But years later, the abandoned Astral Express was repaired and set sail once more. Under the leadership of its navigator, Himeko, it embarked on the Trailblaze journey anew.

Yes, this is the legendary place where the Astral Express restarted its journey. May Akivili watch over us, just as Aha bestowed THEIR blessing upon this arcadia.
